#!/bin/bash
cd /testbed

# Ensure MariaDB is running
if ! mysqladmin -u root ping --silent 2>/dev/null; then
    mkdir -p /run/mysqld && chown mysql:mysql /run/mysqld
    mysqld_safe &
    sleep 3
fi

# Create database and user if they don't exist
mysql -u root -e "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS corteza CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci;" 2>/dev/null
mysql -u root -e "CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS 'corteza'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY 'corteza'; GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON corteza.* TO 'corteza'@'localhost'; FLUSH PRIVILEGES;" 2>/dev/null

# Disable foreign key checks globally (needed due to legacy migration SQL FK reference bug)
mysql -u root -e "SET GLOBAL foreign_key_checks = 0;" 2>/dev/null

# Write .env for the test suite
cat > /testbed/.env << 'EOF'
DB_DSN=corteza:corteza@tcp(localhost:3306)/corteza?collation=utf8mb4_general_ci
LOG_LEVEL=error
EOF

# Set up GOPATH symlink if needed
export GOPATH=/root/go
export GO111MODULE=off
mkdir -p /root/go/src/github.com/cortezaproject
if [ ! -L /root/go/src/github.com/cortezaproject/corteza-server ]; then
    ln -sf /testbed /root/go/src/github.com/cortezaproject/corteza-server
fi

# Run role integration tests
cd /root/go/src/github.com/cortezaproject/corteza-server
go test -v -count=1 ./tests/system/ -run "TestRole"

+package alertmanager
+
+import (
+	"bytes"
+	"io/ioutil"
+	"net/http"
+	"net/http/httptest"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"testing"
+
+	util_log "github.com/cortexproject/cortex/pkg/util/log"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"github.com/weaveworks/common/user"
+)
+
+func postAlertmanagerUserConfigForOAuth2Test(t *testing.T, cfg string) (int, string) {
+	t.Helper()
+
+	am := &MultitenantAlertmanager{
+		store:  prepareInMemoryAlertStore(),
+		logger: util_log.Logger,
+	}
+	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "http://alertmanager/api/v1/alerts", bytes.NewReader([]byte(cfg)))
+	ctx := user.InjectOrgID(req.Context(), "oauth2-test-tenant")
+	w := httptest.NewRecorder()
+	am.SetUserConfig(w, req.WithContext(ctx))
+
+	resp := w.Result()
+	defer resp.Body.Close()
+	body, err := ioutil.ReadAll(resp.Body)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	return resp.StatusCode, string(body)
+}
+
+func TestAlertmanagerTenantConfigAcceptsInlineOAuth2(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+
+	cfg := `
+alertmanager_config: |
+  receivers:
+    - name: default-receiver
+      webhook_configs:
+        - url: http://localhost
+          http_config:
+            oauth2:
+              client_id: tenant-client
+              client_secret: inline-secret
+              token_url: http://token.example.test
+
+  route:
+    receiver: 'default-receiver'
+`
+
+	status, body := postAlertmanagerUserConfigForOAuth2Test(t, cfg)
+	if status != http.StatusCreated {
+		t.Fatalf("expected tenant Alertmanager config with inline OAuth2 secret to validate, got status %d body %q", status, body)
+	}
+	if body != "" {
+		t.Fatalf("expected empty response body for accepted config, got %q", body)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestValidateUserConfigRejectsOAuth2ClientSecretFile(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+
+	nonexistentSecretPath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "oauth2-client-secret")
+	tests := []struct {
+		name string
+		cfg  string
+	}{
+		{
+			name: "global http config",
+			cfg: `
+alertmanager_config: |
+  global:
+    http_config:
+      oauth2:
+        client_id: tenant-client
+        token_url: http://token.example.test
+        client_secret_file: ` + nonexistentSecretPath + `
+
+  route:
+    receiver: 'default-receiver'
+  receivers:
+    - name: default-receiver
+`,
+		},
+		{
+			name: "receiver webhook http config",
+			cfg: `
+alertmanager_config: |
+  receivers:
+    - name: default-receiver
+      webhook_configs:
+        - url: http://localhost
+          http_config:
+            oauth2:
+              client_id: tenant-client
+              token_url: http://token.example.test
+              client_secret_file: ` + nonexistentSecretPath + `
+
+  route:
+    receiver: 'default-receiver'
+`,
+		},
+	}
+
+	for _, tc := range tests {
+		tc := tc
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			t.Parallel()
+
+			status, body := postAlertmanagerUserConfigForOAuth2Test(t, tc.cfg)
+			if status != http.StatusBadRequest {
+				t.Fatalf("expected OAuth2 client_secret_file to be rejected with HTTP 400, got status %d body %q", status, body)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}

+import contextlib

 import sqlalchemy.orm

+@contextlib.contextmanager
+def _capture_function_table_writes(db: sqlalchemy.orm.Session):
+    statements = []
+    bind = db.get_bind()
+
+    def before_cursor_execute(
+        conn, cursor, statement, parameters, context, executemany
+    ):
+        normalized = " ".join(statement.lower().split())
+        is_function_write = (
+            normalized.startswith("update ")
+            or normalized.startswith("insert ")
+            or normalized.startswith("replace ")
+        ) and "functions" in normalized
+        if is_function_write:
+            statements.append(statement)
+
+    sqlalchemy.event.listen(bind, "before_cursor_execute", before_cursor_execute)
+    try:
+        yield statements
+    finally:
+        sqlalchemy.event.remove(bind, "before_cursor_execute", before_cursor_execute)
+

+from collections.abc import Iterator
+from typing import Any, Optional
+
+import pytest
+
+from ape.api.query import BlockQuery, QueryAPI, QueryType
+from ape.exceptions import QueryEngineError
+from ape.managers.query import QueryManager
+
+
+class ScriptedCodespecEngine(QueryAPI):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        name: str,
+        estimate: Optional[int] = None,
+        values: tuple[Any, ...] = (),
+        *,
+        estimate_error: Optional[Exception] = None,
+        call_error: Optional[Exception] = None,
+        iteration_error: Optional[Exception] = None,
+        events: Optional[list[str]] = None,
+        cache_error: Optional[QueryEngineError] = None,
+    ):
+        self.name = name
+        self.estimate = estimate
+        self.values = values
+        self.estimate_error = estimate_error
+        self.call_error = call_error
+        self.iteration_error = iteration_error
+        self.events = events if events is not None else []
+        self.cache_error = cache_error
+        self.cached: list[Any] = []
+
+    def estimate_query(self, query: QueryType) -> Optional[int]:
+        self.events.append(f"estimate:{self.name}")
+        if self.estimate_error:
+            raise self.estimate_error
+
+        return self.estimate
+
+    def perform_query(self, query: QueryType) -> Iterator:
+        self.events.append(f"perform:{self.name}")
+        if self.call_error:
+            raise self.call_error
+
+        def generate():
+            yield from self.values
+            if self.iteration_error:
+                raise self.iteration_error
+
+        return generate()
+
+    def update_cache(self, query: QueryType, result: Iterator):
+        if self.cache_error:
+            raise self.cache_error
+
+        self.cached.extend(result)
+
+
+def make_engine(name: str, *args, **kwargs) -> ScriptedCodespecEngine:
+
+    engine_type = type(f"{name.title()}CodespecEngine", (ScriptedCodespecEngine,), {})
+    return engine_type(name, *args, **kwargs)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def query():
+    return BlockQuery(columns=["number"], start_block=0, stop_block=1)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def manager_for(monkeypatch):
+    def create(*engines):
+        engine_map = {engine.name: engine for engine in engines}
+        monkeypatch.setattr(QueryManager, "engines", property(lambda self: engine_map))
+        return QueryManager()
+
+    return create
+
+
+def test_codespec_automatic_skips_unavailable_and_estimation_errors(query, manager_for):
+    events: list[str] = []
+    unavailable = make_engine("unavailable", None, ("wrong",), events=events)
+    broken_estimate = make_engine(
+        "broken-estimate",
+        estimate_error=QueryEngineError("estimate offline"),
+        values=("wrong",),
+        events=events,
+    )
+    winner = make_engine("winner", 5, ("winner-result",), events=events)
+    manager = manager_for(unavailable, broken_estimate, winner)
+
+    assert list(manager.query(query)) == ["winner-result"]
+    assert [event for event in events if event.startswith("perform:")] == ["perform:winner"]
+
+
+def test_codespec_automatic_order_retries_execution_errors(query, manager_for):
+    events: list[str] = []
+    fastest = make_engine(
+        "fastest", 1, call_error=QueryEngineError("fastest unavailable"), events=events
+    )
+    winner = make_engine("winner", 5, ("winner-result",), events=events)
+    slower = make_engine("slower", 50, ("wrong",), events=events)
+    manager = manager_for(slower, winner, fastest)
+
+    assert list(manager.query(query)) == ["winner-result"]
+    assert [event for event in events if event.startswith("perform:")] == [
+        "perform:fastest",
+        "perform:winner",
+    ]
+
+
+def test_codespec_equal_estimates_keep_registration_order(query, manager_for):
+    events: list[str] = []
+    first = make_engine("first", 7, ("first-result",), events=events)
+    second = make_engine("second", 7, ("second-result",), events=events)
+    manager = manager_for(first, second)
+
+    assert list(manager.query(query)) == ["first-result"]
+    assert "perform:second" not in events
+
+
+def test_codespec_iteration_failure_discards_partial_values(query, manager_for):
+    events: list[str] = []
+    partial = make_engine(
+        "partial",
+        1,
+        ("must-not-leak",),
+        iteration_error=QueryEngineError("stream interrupted"),
+        events=events,
+    )
+    winner = make_engine("winner", 2, ("complete-1", "complete-2"), events=events)
+    manager = manager_for(partial, winner)
+
+    assert list(manager.query(query)) == ["complete-1", "complete-2"]
+    assert [event for event in events if event.startswith("perform:")] == [
+        "perform:partial",
+        "perform:winner",
+    ]
+
+
+def test_codespec_successful_fallback_is_the_only_cache_source(query, manager_for):
+    failed = make_engine(
+        "failed",
+        1,
+        ("partial",),
+        iteration_error=QueryEngineError("failed late"),
+    )
+    winner = make_engine("winner", 2, ("good-1", "good-2"))
+    observer = make_engine("observer", None)
+    manager = manager_for(failed, winner, observer)
+
+    assert list(manager.query(query)) == ["good-1", "good-2"]
+    assert failed.cached == ["good-1", "good-2"]
+    assert observer.cached == ["good-1", "good-2"]
+    assert winner.cached == []
+
+
+def test_codespec_cache_rejection_does_not_change_query_success(query, manager_for):
+    winner = make_engine("winner", 1, ("good",))
+    rejecting_cache = make_engine(
+        "rejecting-cache", None, cache_error=QueryEngineError("cache unavailable")
+    )
+    manager = manager_for(winner, rejecting_cache)
+
+    assert list(manager.query(query)) == ["good"]
+
+

+import numpy as np

+
+from lenstronomy.LensModel.lens_model import LensModel

+
+
+KWARGS_LENS = [{"theta_E": 1, "center_x": 0, "center_y": 0}]
+
+
+def _sis_lens_model():
+    return LensModel(lens_model_list=["SIS"])
+
+
+def _source_position_point_source(*, fixed_magnification=False):
+    return PointSource(
+        point_source_type_list=["SOURCE_POSITION"],
+        lens_model=_sis_lens_model(),
+        fixed_magnification_list=[fixed_magnification],
+        magnification_limit=None,
+        kwargs_lens_eqn_solver=None,
+        redshift_list=None,
+    )
+
+
+def _first_component_xy(position_tuple):
+    return position_tuple[0][0], position_tuple[1][0]
+
+
+def _assert_two_sis_images_for_source(x_image, y_image, ra_source=0.1, dec_source=0.0):
+
+    assert len(x_image) == 2
+    assert len(y_image) == 2
+    order = np.argsort(np.asarray(x_image))
+    expected_x = [ra_source - 1.0, ra_source + 1.0]
+    np.testing.assert_allclose(np.asarray(x_image)[order], expected_x, atol=1e-5)
+    np.testing.assert_allclose(np.asarray(y_image)[order], [0.0, 0.0], atol=1e-5)
+
+    ray_x, ray_y = _sis_lens_model().ray_shooting(x_image, y_image, KWARGS_LENS)
+    np.testing.assert_allclose(ray_x, [ra_source, ra_source], atol=1e-5)
+    np.testing.assert_allclose(ray_y, [dec_source, dec_source], atol=1e-5)
+
+
+def test_source_position_session_solves_images_and_uses_explicit_point_amp():
+
+
+
+    kwargs_ps = [{"ra_source": 0.1, "dec_source": 0.0, "point_amp": [2, 1]}]
+    point_source = _source_position_point_source(fixed_magnification=False)
+
+    assert point_source.point_source_type_list == ["SOURCE_POSITION"]
+
+    x_source_list, y_source_list = point_source.source_position(kwargs_ps, KWARGS_LENS)
+    np.testing.assert_allclose([float(x_source_list[0])], [0.1], atol=0.0, rtol=0.0)
+    np.testing.assert_allclose([float(y_source_list[0])], [0.0], atol=0.0, rtol=0.0)
+
+    x_image, y_image = _first_component_xy(
+        point_source.image_position(kwargs_ps, KWARGS_LENS)
+    )
+    _assert_two_sis_images_for_source(x_image, y_image)
+
+    image_amp = point_source.image_amplitude(kwargs_ps, KWARGS_LENS)
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(image_amp[0], np.array([2, 1]))
+
+    source_amp = point_source.source_amplitude(kwargs_ps, KWARGS_LENS)
+
+    assert len(source_amp) == 1
+    assert np.isfinite(float(source_amp[0]))
+
+    ra_array, dec_array, amp_array = point_source.point_source_list(
+        kwargs_ps, KWARGS_LENS
+    )
+    _assert_two_sis_images_for_source(ra_array, dec_array)
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(amp_array, np.array([2, 1]))
+

+def test_scalar_point_amp_expands_to_each_solved_image():
+
+
+
+    kwargs_ps = [{"ra_source": 0.1, "dec_source": 0.0, "point_amp": 3.0}]
+    point_source = _source_position_point_source(fixed_magnification=False)
+
+    image_amp = point_source.image_amplitude(kwargs_ps, KWARGS_LENS)
+    np.testing.assert_allclose(image_amp[0], [3.0, 3.0], atol=0.0, rtol=0.0)
+

+
+    ra_array, dec_array, amp_array = point_source.point_source_list(
+        kwargs_ps, KWARGS_LENS
+    )
+    _assert_two_sis_images_for_source(ra_array, dec_array)
+    np.testing.assert_allclose(amp_array, [3.0, 3.0], atol=0.0, rtol=0.0)
+
+
+def test_fixed_magnification_uses_source_amp_and_absolute_sis_magnification():
+
+
+
+    kwargs_ps = [{"ra_source": 0.1, "dec_source": 0.0, "source_amp": 3.0}]

+    )
+
+    np.testing.assert_allclose(image_amp[0], expected_amp, atol=1e-5, rtol=0.0)
+
+    source_amp = point_source.source_amplitude(kwargs_ps, KWARGS_LENS)
+    np.testing.assert_allclose([float(source_amp[0])], [3.0], atol=0.0, rtol=0.0)

+    ra_array, dec_array, amp_array = point_source.point_source_list(

+

+
+
+

+def _endpoint_from_repr(adapter):

+# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+
+import numpy as np
+import pytest
+
+from sktime.classification.early_classification import TEASER
+from sktime.classification.interval_based import TimeSeriesForestClassifier
+from sktime.datasets import load_unit_test
+from sktime.datatypes._panel._convert import from_nested_to_3d_numpy
+
+CLASSIFICATION_POINTS = [6, 16, 24]
+
+
+def _fit_teaser():
+    X_train, y_train = load_unit_test(split="train", return_X_y=True)
+    clf = TEASER(
+        random_state=0,
+        classification_points=CLASSIFICATION_POINTS,
+        estimator=TimeSeriesForestClassifier(n_estimators=10, random_state=0),
+    )
+    clf.fit(X_train, y_train)
+    return clf
+
+
+def _load_test_3d():
+    X_test, y_test = load_unit_test(split="test", return_X_y=True)
+    return from_nested_to_3d_numpy(X_test), y_test
+
+
+def test_teaser_fit_returns_self():
+
+    X_train, y_train = load_unit_test(split="train", return_X_y=True)
+    clf = TEASER(
+        classification_points=CLASSIFICATION_POINTS,
+        estimator=TimeSeriesForestClassifier(n_estimators=5, random_state=0),
+        random_state=0,
+    )
+    assert clf.fit(X_train, y_train) is clf
+
+
+def test_teaser_predict_labels():
+
+    clf = _fit_teaser()
+    X_test, y_test = _load_test_3d()
+
+    preds = np.asarray(clf.predict(X_test))
+    assert preds.shape == (X_test.shape[0],)
+    assert set(np.unique(preds)).issubset(set(clf.classes_))
+
+    assert np.mean(preds == y_test) > 0.5
+
+
+def test_teaser_predict_proba_full_length():
+
+    clf = _fit_teaser()
+    X_test, _ = _load_test_3d()
+    n = X_test.shape[0]
+
+    result = clf.predict_proba(X_test)
+    assert len(result) == 3
+    probas, decisions, state_info = result
+    probas = np.asarray(probas)
+    decisions = np.asarray(decisions)
+
+    assert probas.shape == (n, len(clf.classes_))
+    assert decisions.shape == (n,)
+    assert len(state_info) == n
+
+
+    assert decisions.astype(bool).all()
+
+    assert np.all(probas >= 0)
+    np.testing.assert_allclose(probas.sum(axis=1), np.ones(n), atol=1e-6)
+
+
+def test_teaser_streaming_monotonic_decisions():
+
+    clf = _fit_teaser()
+    X_test, _ = _load_test_3d()
+    n = X_test.shape[0]
+
+    states = None
+    decided = np.zeros(n, dtype=bool)
+    for cp in CLASSIFICATION_POINTS:
+        probas, decisions, states = clf.predict_proba(
+            X_test[:, :, :cp], state_info=states
+        )
+        probas = np.asarray(probas)
+        decisions = np.asarray(decisions).astype(bool)
+
+        assert len(states) == n
+
+        assert np.all(decisions[decided])
+
+        for i in np.flatnonzero(decisions):
+            assert np.all(probas[i] >= 0)
+            np.testing.assert_allclose(probas[i].sum(), 1.0, atol=1e-6)
+        decided = decided | decisions
+
+
+    assert decided.all()
+
+
+def test_teaser_score():
+
+    clf = _fit_teaser()
+    X_test, y_test = _load_test_3d()
+
+    result = clf.score(X_test, y_test)
+    assert len(result) == 3
+    harmonic_mean, accuracy, earliness = (float(v) for v in result)
+
+    for v in (harmonic_mean, accuracy, earliness):
+        assert 0.0 <= v <= 1.0
+
+
+    assert accuracy > 0.5
+
+    assert earliness > 0.0
+
+
+    denom = accuracy + (1 - earliness)
+    expected = 2 * accuracy * (1 - earliness) / denom if denom > 0 else 0.0
+    np.testing.assert_allclose(harmonic_mean, expected, atol=1e-6)
+
+
+def test_teaser_unknown_length_raises():
+
+    clf = _fit_teaser()
+    X_test, _ = _load_test_3d()
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        clf.predict_proba(X_test[:, :, :10])

+    the default template (rather than a user-defined name) must error rather
+    than silently returning the default's children.
+
+    Original bug: c.getkeys('datasheet', 'package', 'pin') returned the keys
+    inside the default package schema (['type', 'drawing', ...]) instead of
+    flagging that 'pin' is not a valid key at that depth.
+    """

+    with pytest.raises(siliconcompiler.core.SiliconCompilerError):

+def test_getkeys_unset_name_raises():
+    """getkeys() on an unset user-defined name must raise.
+
+    Without the fix, an unset name silently falls through to the 'default'
+    template and getkeys returns the default's children.
+    """
+    chip = siliconcompiler.Chip('test')
+    with pytest.raises(siliconcompiler.core.SiliconCompilerError):
+        chip.getkeys('datasheet', 'package', 'mypkg')
+

+    """getkeys() on an unset name followed by a valid sub-key must raise."""
+    chip = siliconcompiler.Chip('test')
+    with pytest.raises(siliconcompiler.core.SiliconCompilerError):
+        chip.getkeys('datasheet', 'package', 'mypkg', 'pin')
+
+
+def test_getkeys_unset_intermediate_default_raises():
+    """getkeys() on an unset key that has triple-nested defaults must raise.
+
+    chip.getkeys('input', 'constraint') used to silently substitute the
+    default for 'constraint' and return its children. Now it must error.
+    """
+    chip = siliconcompiler.Chip('test')
+    with pytest.raises(siliconcompiler.core.SiliconCompilerError):
+        chip.getkeys('input', 'constraint')
+
+
+def test_getkeys_valid_default_keypath():
+    """Explicit 'default' is a legal key and getkeys() must return its
+    children unchanged after the fix.
+    """
+    chip = siliconcompiler.Chip('test')
+    keys = chip.getkeys('datasheet', 'package', 'default')
+
+    for expected in ('type', 'drawing', 'pincount', 'pin'):
+        assert expected in keys
+
+
+def test_getkeys_valid_parent_keypath():
+    """getkeys() on a valid parent without any user-defined names returns an

+    """

+import importlib

+
+from arcade.gui import UIAnchorLayout, UIGridLayout
+
+
+def load_color_picker_module():
+    return importlib.import_module("arcade.examples.gui.5_uicolor_picker")
+
+

+    module = load_color_picker_module()
+    added_to = defaultdict(list)
+    grid_children = set()
+
+    anchor_add = UIAnchorLayout.add
+    grid_add = UIGridLayout.add
+
+    def record_anchor_add(self, child, *args, **kwargs):
+        added_to[child].append(type(self).__name__)
+        return anchor_add(self, child, *args, **kwargs)

+import warnings
+
+from arcade.gui import UIBoxLayout, UIWidget
+
+
+WARNING_MESSAGE = "Container size is 0, cannot calculate sizes for children."
+
+
+def layout_children(vertical, container_width, container_height, child_sizes):
+    layout = UIBoxLayout(vertical=vertical, width=container_width, height=container_height)
+    children = []
+
+    for width, height in child_sizes:
+        child = UIWidget(
+            width=width,
+            height=height,
+            size_hint=(1, 1),
+            size_hint_min=(width, height),
+        )
+        layout.add(child)
+        children.append(child)
+
+    with warnings.catch_warnings():
+        warnings.simplefilter("ignore")
+        layout.do_layout()
+
+    return children
+
+
+def axis_sizes(children, axis):
+    if axis == "width":
+        return [child.width for child in children]
+    return [child.height for child in children]
+
+
+def warning_messages_for_layout(vertical, container_width, container_height, child_sizes):
+    layout = UIBoxLayout(vertical=vertical, width=container_width, height=container_height)
+    for width, height in child_sizes:
+        layout.add(
+            UIWidget(
+                width=width,
+                height=height,
+                size_hint=(1, 1),
+                size_hint_min=(width, height),
+            )
+        )
+
+    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
+        warnings.simplefilter("always")
+        layout.do_layout()
+
+    return [str(entry.message) for entry in caught]
+
+
+def test_horizontal_box_zero_available_width_uses_child_minimums():
+    children = layout_children(False, 0, 90, [(10, 12), (25, 12), (40, 12)])
+
+    assert axis_sizes(children, "width") == [10, 25, 40]
+
+
+def test_horizontal_box_negative_available_width_uses_child_minimums():
+    children = layout_children(False, -7, 90, [(10, 12), (25, 12), (40, 12)])
+
+    assert axis_sizes(children, "width") == [10, 25, 40]
+
+
+def test_vertical_box_zero_available_height_uses_child_minimums():
+    children = layout_children(True, 90, 0, [(12, 11), (12, 27), (12, 43)])
+
+    assert axis_sizes(children, "height") == [11, 27, 43]
+
+
+def test_zero_available_size_warns_with_promised_message():
+    messages = warning_messages_for_layout(False, 0, 90, [(10, 12), (25, 12), (40, 12)])
+
+
+    assert WARNING_MESSAGE in messages
+
+
+def test_negative_available_size_warns_with_promised_message():
+    messages = warning_messages_for_layout(False, -7, 90, [(10, 12), (25, 12), (40, 12)])
+
+
+    assert WARNING_MESSAGE in messages

+package node_test
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/rancher/rancher/pkg/node"
+	v3 "github.com/rancher/types/apis/management.cattle.io/v3"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	corev1 "k8s.io/api/core/v1"
+	metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
+)
+
+const unreachableTaintKey = "node.kubernetes.io/unreachable"
+
+
+func machineWith(taints []corev1.Taint, readyStatus corev1.ConditionStatus, includeReady bool) *v3.Node {
+	machine := &v3.Node{}
+	machine.Spec.InternalNodeSpec.Taints = taints
+	if includeReady {
+		machine.Status.InternalNodeStatus.Conditions = []corev1.NodeCondition{
+			{
+				Type:   corev1.NodeReady,
+				Status: readyStatus,
+			},
+		}
+	}
+	return machine
+}
+
+
+
+func makeUnreachableTaint(effect corev1.TaintEffect, added *time.Time) corev1.Taint {
+	t := corev1.Taint{
+		Key:    unreachableTaintKey,
+		Effect: effect,
+	}
+	if added != nil {
+		t.TimeAdded = &metav1.Time{Time: *added}
+	}
+	return t
+}
+
+func TestIsNodeUnreachable(t *testing.T) {
+	now := time.Now()
+
+	tests := []struct {
+		name    string
+		machine *v3.Node
+		want    bool
+	}{
+		{
+			name:    "unreachable taint NoExecute and Ready Unknown",
+			machine: machineWith([]corev1.Taint{makeUnreachableTaint(corev1.TaintEffectNoExecute, &now)}, corev1.ConditionUnknown, true),
+			want:    true,
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "unreachable taint without recorded time still unreachable",
+			machine: machineWith([]corev1.Taint{makeUnreachableTaint(corev1.TaintEffectNoExecute, nil)}, corev1.ConditionUnknown, true),
+			want:    true,
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "no taints",
+			machine: machineWith(nil, corev1.ConditionUnknown, true),
+			want:    false,
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "unreachable taint but Ready True",
+			machine: machineWith([]corev1.Taint{makeUnreachableTaint(corev1.TaintEffectNoExecute, &now)}, corev1.ConditionTrue, true),
+			want:    false,
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "unreachable taint but Ready False",
+			machine: machineWith([]corev1.Taint{makeUnreachableTaint(corev1.TaintEffectNoExecute, &now)}, corev1.ConditionFalse, true),
+			want:    false,
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "unreachable taint but no Ready condition",
+			machine: machineWith([]corev1.Taint{makeUnreachableTaint(corev1.TaintEffectNoExecute, &now)}, "", false),
+			want:    false,
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "same key but NoSchedule effect does not count",
+			machine: machineWith([]corev1.Taint{makeUnreachableTaint(corev1.TaintEffectNoSchedule, &now)}, corev1.ConditionUnknown, true),
+			want:    false,
+		},
+		{
+			name: "unrelated taint with Ready Unknown",
+			machine: machineWith([]corev1.Taint{{
+				Key:    "some.other/taint",
+				Effect: corev1.TaintEffectNoExecute,
+			}}, corev1.ConditionUnknown, true),
+			want: false,
+		},
+		{
+			name: "matching taint ignores value",
+			machine: machineWith([]corev1.Taint{{
+				Key:    unreachableTaintKey,
+				Value:  "anything",
+				Effect: corev1.TaintEffectNoExecute,
+			}}, corev1.ConditionUnknown, true),
+			want: true,
+		},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.want, node.IsNodeUnreachable(tt.machine))
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestShouldDeleteUnreachableNode(t *testing.T) {
+	now := time.Now()
+	longAgo := now.Add(-time.Hour)
+	recent := now.Add(-time.Second)
+
+	tests := []struct {
+		name    string
+		machine *v3.Node
+		timeout time.Duration
+		want    bool
+	}{
+		{
+			name:    "unreachable longer than timeout",
+			machine: machineWith([]corev1.Taint{makeUnreachableTaint(corev1.TaintEffectNoExecute, &longAgo)}, corev1.ConditionUnknown, true),
+			timeout: time.Minute,
+			want:    true,
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "unreachable but not yet past timeout",
+			machine: machineWith([]corev1.Taint{makeUnreachableTaint(corev1.TaintEffectNoExecute, &recent)}, corev1.ConditionUnknown, true),
+			timeout: time.Hour,
+			want:    false,
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "timeout zero disables deletion even when long unreachable",
+			machine: machineWith([]corev1.Taint{makeUnreachableTaint(corev1.TaintEffectNoExecute, &longAgo)}, corev1.ConditionUnknown, true),
+			timeout: 0,
+			want:    false,
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "negative timeout disables deletion",
+			machine: machineWith([]corev1.Taint{makeUnreachableTaint(corev1.TaintEffectNoExecute, &longAgo)}, corev1.ConditionUnknown, true),
+			timeout: -time.Minute,
+			want:    false,
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "taint without recorded add-time is never deletable",
+			machine: machineWith([]corev1.Taint{makeUnreachableTaint(corev1.TaintEffectNoExecute, nil)}, corev1.ConditionUnknown, true),
+			timeout: time.Minute,
+			want:    false,
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "not unreachable (Ready True) is never deletable",
+			machine: machineWith([]corev1.Taint{makeUnreachableTaint(corev1.TaintEffectNoExecute, &longAgo)}, corev1.ConditionTrue, true),
+			timeout: time.Minute,
+			want:    false,
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "no taints is never deletable",
+			machine: machineWith(nil, corev1.ConditionUnknown, true),
+			timeout: time.Minute,
+			want:    false,
+		},
+		{
+			name:    "same key NoSchedule effect is never deletable",
+			machine: machineWith([]corev1.Taint{makeUnreachableTaint(corev1.TaintEffectNoSchedule, &longAgo)}, corev1.ConditionUnknown, true),
+			timeout: time.Minute,
+			want:    false,
+		},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.want, node.ShouldDeleteUnreachableNode(tt.machine, tt.timeout))
+		})
+	}
+}

set -e

# Use Python 3.11 (compatible with this older scikit-bio)
dev-switch python3 3.11

# System-level compatibility fixes (persist outside /testbed)
# 1. Patch collections module for Python 3.10+ compat
cat > /usr/lib/python3.11/sitecustomize.py << 'SITECUSTOMIZE'
import collections
import collections.abc
for _a in ('Sequence', 'Mapping', 'MutableMapping', 'MutableSet',
           'Callable', 'Iterator', 'Iterable', 'MutableSequence',
           'Set', 'Hashable', 'Sized', 'Container'):
    if not hasattr(collections, _a):
        setattr(collections, _a, getattr(collections.abc, _a, None))
SITECUSTOMIZE

# 2. Symlink longintrepr.h for old Cython-generated C files
if [ ! -f /usr/include/python3.11/longintrepr.h ]; then
    ln -s /usr/include/python3.11/cpython/longintrepr.h /usr/include/python3.11/longintrepr.h
fi

# Create venv (outside /testbed so it persists across resets)
VENV_DIR=/opt/skbio_venv
python3 -m venv "$VENV_DIR"
source "$VENV_DIR/bin/activate"

# Install build tools
pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel Cython==0.29.37 pytest

# Install dependencies with compatible versions
pip install 'numpy<1.24' 'scipy<1.12' 'pandas<2.0' 'scikit-learn<1.3' \
    'matplotlib<3.8' natsort decorator lockfile CacheControl IPython \
    hdmedians nose

# Create pandas.util.testing compat shim (removed in pandas 1.5+)
cat > "$VENV_DIR/lib/python3.11/site-packages/pandas/util/testing.py" << 'PDTEST'
from pandas._testing import *
PDTEST

# Regenerate C extensions from .pyx files (old .c files incompatible with 3.11)
cython skbio/metadata/_intersection.pyx
cython skbio/stats/__subsample.pyx
cython skbio/diversity/_phylogenetic.pyx
cython skbio/alignment/_ssw_wrapper.pyx

# Build C extensions in-place
python3 -c "
from setuptools import Distribution, Extension
import numpy as np
extensions = [
    Extension('skbio.metadata._intersection', ['skbio/metadata/_intersection.c']),
    Extension('skbio.stats.__subsample', ['skbio/stats/__subsample.c'], include_dirs=[np.get_include()]),
    Extension('skbio.alignment._ssw_wrapper', ['skbio/alignment/_ssw_wrapper.c', 'skbio/alignment/_lib/ssw.c'], extra_compile_args=['-Wno-error=declaration-after-statement'], include_dirs=[np.get_include()]),
    Extension('skbio.diversity._phylogenetic', ['skbio/diversity/_phylogenetic.c'], include_dirs=[np.get_include()])
]
dist = Distribution({'ext_modules': extensions})
cmd = dist.get_command_obj('build_ext')
cmd.inplace = 1
cmd.ensure_finalized()
cmd.run()
"

python3 -m pytest skbio/tree/tests/test_tree.py -v

+def _identity_tuple(substance):
+

+    assert len(matches) == 1
+    return matches[0]

+def _assert_loaded_substance(actual, sid, pmclass=None):
+
+    assert actual is _loaded_catalog_entry(sid)
+    assert actual.sid() == sid
+    if pmclass is not None:
+        assert actual.pmclass() == pmclass
+
+
+def _assert_invalid_substance_error(excinfo, output, missing_sid):
+
+    assert isinstance(excinfo.value, pm.utility.PMParamError)
+    normalized = " ".join(output.lower().split())
+    assert missing_sid.lower() in normalized
+    assert "found" in normalized
+    assert ("not" in normalized) or ("no" in normalized)
+
+
+def _catalog_fingerprint():
+    return sorted((substance.sid(), substance.pmclass()) for substance in pm.search())
+
+

+
+
+
+    actual = pm.get("ig.O2")
+
+

+
+
+def test_get_returns_exact_multiphase_water():
+
+
+
+    actual = pm.get("mp.H2O")
+
+

+

+
+
+

+
+

+

+
+

+
+
+

+    return httpx.Response(

+
+  return httpx.MockTransport(handler)

+def _blob_transport(records, status_code):

+    return httpx.Response(status_code)
+
+  return httpx.MockTransport(handler)

+class _RecordingHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+  protocol_version = 'HTTP/1.1'
+
+  def do_POST(self):
+    length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', '0'))
+    payload = self.rfile.read(length)
+    self.server.records.append((self.command, self.path, json.loads(payload.decode())))

+    body = b'{"status":"success"}'
+    self.send_response(200)
+    self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
+    self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(body)))
+    if self.server.close_after_response:

+    self.end_headers()
+    self.wfile.write(body)
+
+  def log_message(self, format, *args):

+

+    self._server = ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', 0), _RecordingHandler)

+    self._server.close_after_response = close_after_response
+    self.url = f'http://127.0.0.1:{self._server.server_port}'
+    self._thread = threading.Thread(target=self._server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
+
+  @property
+  def records(self):
+    return self._server.records
+
+  def __enter__(self):
+    self._thread.start()
+    return self

+    self._server.shutdown()
+    self._server.server_close()

+"""
+Tests for automatic IAM database username formatting.
+
+These tests exercise the user-facing entry point Connector.connect(...)
+with enable_iam_auth=True and verify that the `user` kwarg passed down
+to the underlying driver is correctly formatted based on the Cloud SQL
+database engine version (Postgres vs. MySQL).
+"""
+import datetime
+from typing import Any, Dict
+
+import pytest  # noqa F401 Needed to run the tests
+from mock import patch
+
+from google.cloud.sql.connector import Connector
+
+
+class _FakeMetadata:
+
+
+    def __init__(self, database_version: str) -> None:
+        self.database_version = database_version
+        self.context = None
+        self.ip_addrs = {"PRIMARY": "127.0.0.1"}
+        self.expiration = datetime.datetime.now() + datetime.timedelta(minutes=10)
+
+
+class _FakeInstance:
+
+
+    def __init__(self, database_version: str, enable_iam_auth: bool) -> None:
+        self._enable_iam_auth = enable_iam_auth
+        self._database_version = database_version
+
+    async def connect_info(self, ip_type: Any) -> Any:
+        return _FakeMetadata(self._database_version), "127.0.0.1"
+
+    async def close(self) -> None:
+        return None
+
+    def force_refresh(self) -> None:
+        return None
+
+
+def _capture_driver_kwargs(
+    database_version: str,
+    driver: str,
+    user: str,
+    enable_iam_auth: bool = True,
+) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+
+
+
+
+
+
+    captured: Dict[str, Any] = {}
+
+    def _fake_sync_connect(ip_address: str, ctx: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
+        captured.update(kwargs)
+        return "fake_connection"
+
+    async def _fake_async_connect(ip_address: str, ctx: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
+        captured.update(kwargs)
+        return "fake_connection"
+
+    connector = Connector(enable_iam_auth=enable_iam_auth)
+    try:
+        connect_string = "test-project:test-region:test-instance"
+        connector._instances[connect_string] = _FakeInstance(  # type: ignore[assignment]
+            database_version, enable_iam_auth=enable_iam_auth
+        )
+        with patch(
+            "google.cloud.sql.connector.pg8000.connect",
+            side_effect=_fake_sync_connect,
+        ), patch(
+            "google.cloud.sql.connector.pymysql.connect",
+            side_effect=_fake_sync_connect,
+        ), patch(
+            "google.cloud.sql.connector.asyncpg.connect",
+            side_effect=_fake_async_connect,
+        ):
+            connector.connect(
+                connect_string,
+                driver,
+                user=user,
+                password="my-pass",
+                db="my-db",
+            )
+    finally:
+
+        try:
+            connector.close()
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+    return captured
+
+
+
+
+
+
+
+def test_postgres_iam_user_with_gserviceaccount_suffix_is_truncated() -> None:
+
+
+
+
+
+    kwargs = _capture_driver_kwargs(
+        database_version="POSTGRES_14",
+        driver="pg8000",
+        user="test-user@my-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com",
+    )
+    assert kwargs["user"] == "test-user@my-project.iam"
+
+
+def test_postgres_iam_user_without_suffix_is_unchanged() -> None:
+
+
+
+
+    kwargs = _capture_driver_kwargs(
+        database_version="POSTGRES_14",
+        driver="pg8000",
+        user="test-user@example.com",
+    )
+    assert kwargs["user"] == "test-user@example.com"
+
+
+def test_postgres_iam_bare_username_is_unchanged() -> None:
+
+
+
+
+    kwargs = _capture_driver_kwargs(
+        database_version="POSTGRES_14",
+        driver="pg8000",
+        user="test-user",
+    )
+    assert kwargs["user"] == "test-user"
+
+
+
+
+
+
+
+def test_mysql_iam_user_with_at_sign_is_truncated() -> None:
+
+
+
+
+    kwargs = _capture_driver_kwargs(
+        database_version="MYSQL_8_0",
+        driver="pymysql",
+        user="test-user@gmail.com",
+    )
+    assert kwargs["user"] == "test-user"
+
+
+def test_mysql_iam_service_account_user_is_truncated() -> None:
+
+
+
+
+
+    kwargs = _capture_driver_kwargs(
+        database_version="MYSQL_8_0",
+        driver="pymysql",
+        user="my-sa@my-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com",
+    )
+    assert kwargs["user"] == "my-sa"
+
+
+def test_mysql_iam_bare_username_is_unchanged() -> None:
+
+
+
+
+    kwargs = _capture_driver_kwargs(
+        database_version="MYSQL_8_0",
+        driver="pymysql",
+        user="test-user",
+    )
+    assert kwargs["user"] == "test-user"
+
+
+
+
+
+
+
+def test_postgres_no_iam_auth_user_is_unchanged() -> None:
+
+
+
+
+
+    kwargs = _capture_driver_kwargs(
+        database_version="POSTGRES_14",
+        driver="pg8000",
+        user="test-user@my-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com",
+        enable_iam_auth=False,
+    )
+    assert kwargs["user"] == "test-user@my-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
+
+
+def test_mysql_no_iam_auth_user_is_unchanged() -> None:
+
+
+
+
+    kwargs = _capture_driver_kwargs(
+        database_version="MYSQL_8_0",
+        driver="pymysql",
+        user="test-user@gmail.com",
+        enable_iam_auth=False,
+    )
+    assert kwargs["user"] == "test-user@gmail.com"

+// given as an example. We treat any visible quoting/delimiting around the

+// as satisfying the user-facing expectation.

+  'Component (?:' +
+    // 'name'  ->  "Component '" + name + "'"
+    "'\" \\+ name \\+ \"'" +
+    '|' +
+    // `name`  ->  "Component `" + name + "`"

+    '|' +
+    // "name" via escaped double-quote literal -> "Component \"" + name + "\""
+    '\\\\"" \\+ name \\+ "\\\\"' +
+    '|' +
+
+    '" \\+ JSON\\.stringify\\(name\\) \\+ "' +
+  ') was not imported, exported, or provided by MDXProvider as global scope'
+)
+

+
+
+

+
+
+

+})

+import torch
+import pytest
+
+from fastNLP.core.predictor import Predictor
+
+
+class _WordVocab(dict):
+    def __missing__(self, token):
+        value = len(self) + 1
+        self[token] = value
+        return value
+
+
+class _LabelVocab:
+    labels = {0: "zero", 1: "one", 2: "two"}
+
+    def to_word(self, index):
+        return self.labels[int(index)]
+
+
+def _make_predictor(task):
+    predictor = object.__new__(Predictor)
+    predictor.batch_size = 1
+    predictor.batch_output = []
+    predictor.word_vocab = _WordVocab()
+    predictor.label_vocab = _LabelVocab()
+    predictor._task = task
+    return predictor
+
+
+class _BaseNetwork:
+    def eval(self):
+        self.is_eval = True
+
+    def train(self):
+        self.is_eval = False
+
+
+class SeqLabelNetwork(_BaseNetwork):
+    def __call__(self, tokens, lengths):
+        return tokens, lengths
+
+    def prediction(self, raw):
+        tokens, lengths = raw
+        decoded = []
+        for row, length in enumerate(lengths.tolist()):
+            decoded.append([int(value) % 3 for value in tokens[row, :length].tolist()])
+        return decoded
+
+
+def test_predictor_predict_seq_label_uses_task_forwarding_and_decodes_labels():
+    predictor = _make_predictor("seq_label")
+    network = SeqLabelNetwork()
+
+    result = predictor.predict(network, [["alpha", "beta"], ["gamma"]])
+
+    assert result == [["one", "two"], ["zero"]]
+    assert network.is_eval is True
+
+
+class TextClassifyNetwork(_BaseNetwork):
+    def __call__(self, tokens):
+        classes = torch.remainder(tokens[:, 0], 3).long()
+        return torch.nn.functional.one_hot(classes, num_classes=3).float()
+
+    def prediction(self, raw):
+        raise AssertionError("classification prediction hook was called")
+
+
+def test_predictor_predict_text_classify_forwards_only_model_input_without_prediction_hook():
+    predictor = _make_predictor("text_classify")
+    network = TextClassifyNetwork()
+
+    result = predictor.predict(network, [["alpha"], ["beta"]])
+
+    assert result == ["one", "two"]
+    assert network.is_eval is True
+
+
+class MustNotBeCalledNetwork(_BaseNetwork):
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.called = False
+
+    def __call__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        self.called = True
+        raise AssertionError("model was called")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("task_name", ["unsupported_task", "foo_bar", "surprising_new_task"])
+def test_predictor_predict_unknown_task_raises_not_implemented_before_model_call(task_name):
+    predictor = _make_predictor(task_name)
+    network = MustNotBeCalledNetwork()
+
+    with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError) as exc_info:
+        predictor.predict(network, [["alpha"]])
+
+    assert network.called is False
+    assert str(exc_info.value)

+from collections.abc import Sequence
+

+

+from griptape.engines.rag.modules import BaseRetrievalRagModule, TextChunksRerankRagModule
+from griptape.engines.rag.stages import RetrievalRagStage
+
+
+@define(kw_only=True)
+class CodespecStaticRetrievalModule(BaseRetrievalRagModule):
+    results: Sequence[BaseArtifact] = field(factory=list)
+    error: Exception | None = field(default=None)
+
+    def run(self, context: RagContext) -> Sequence[BaseArtifact]:
+        if self.error is not None:
+            raise self.error
+        return self.results
+
+
+@define(kw_only=True)
+class CodespecReverseRerankDriver(BaseRerankDriver):
+    def run(self, query: str, artifacts: list[TextArtifact]) -> list[TextArtifact]:
+        return list(reversed(artifacts))
+
+
+def text(value: str, artifact_id: str, **kwargs) -> TextArtifact:
+    return TextArtifact(value, id=artifact_id, **kwargs)
+
+
+def test_a_zero_max_chunks_returns_no_chunks_in_default_mode():
+    module = CodespecStaticRetrievalModule(name="only", results=[text("alpha", "a")])
+    context = RetrievalRagStage(retrieval_modules=[module], max_chunks=0).run(RagContext(query="q"))
+
+    assert context.text_chunks == []
+
+
+def test_context_diagnostics_default_empty_and_round_trip():
+    context = RagContext(query="q")
+
+    assert context.retrieval_scores == {}
+    assert context.retrieval_errors == {}
+
+    restored = RagContext.from_dict(context.to_dict())
+    assert restored.retrieval_scores == {}
+    assert restored.retrieval_errors == {}
+
+
+def test_default_concatenation_is_stable_and_clears_scores():
+    first = text("same", "first", meta={"source": "first"})
+    second = text("same", "second", meta={"source": "second"})
+    left = CodespecStaticRetrievalModule(
+        name="left",
+        results=[InfoArtifact("ignored"), first, text("left-only", "left-only")],
+    )
+    right = CodespecStaticRetrievalModule(
+        name="right",
+        results=[second, text("right-only", "right-only")],
+    )
+    context = RagContext(query="q", retrieval_scores={"stale": 1.0})
+
+    result = RetrievalRagStage(retrieval_modules=[left, right]).run(context)
+
+    assert [chunk.id for chunk in result.text_chunks] == ["first", "left-only", "right-only"]
+    assert result.text_chunks[0].meta == {"source": "first"}
+    assert result.retrieval_scores == {}
+    assert result.retrieval_errors == {}
+
+
+def test_rrf_scores_filter_non_text_and_count_each_module_once():
+    first_a = text("alpha", "a-first", meta={"origin": "left"}, reference=Reference(title="first"))
+    later_a = text("alpha", "a-later", meta={"origin": "right"}, reference=Reference(title="later"))
+    left = CodespecStaticRetrievalModule(
+        name="left",
+        results=[
+            InfoArtifact("does-not-consume-a-rank"),
+            first_a,
+            text("beta", "b-left"),
+            text("alpha", "a-repeat"),
+        ],
+    )
+    right = CodespecStaticRetrievalModule(
+        name="right",
+        results=[text("beta", "b-right"), text("gamma", "c"), later_a],
+    )
+    muted = CodespecStaticRetrievalModule(name="muted", results=[text("delta", "d")])
+
+    result = RetrievalRagStage(
+        retrieval_modules=[left, right, muted],
+        fusion_mode="rrf",
+        rrf_k=10,
+        module_weights={"left": 2, "muted": 0},
+    ).run(RagContext(query="q"))
+
+    assert [chunk.value for chunk in result.text_chunks] == ["alpha", "beta", "gamma", "delta"]
+    assert result.text_chunks[0].id == "a-first"
+    assert result.text_chunks[0].meta == {"origin": "left"}
+    assert result.text_chunks[0].reference.title == "first"
+    assert result.retrieval_scores == pytest.approx(
+        {
+            "a-first": 2 / 11 + 1 / 13,
+            "b-left": 2 / 12 + 1 / 11,
+            "c": 1 / 12,
+            "d": 0,
+        }
+    )
+
+
+def test_rrf_ties_follow_first_configured_appearance():
+    left = CodespecStaticRetrievalModule(name="left", results=[text("alpha", "a"), text("beta", "b-left")])
+    right = CodespecStaticRetrievalModule(
+        name="right", results=[text("beta", "b-right"), text("alpha", "a-right")]
+    )
+
+    result = RetrievalRagStage(retrieval_modules=[left, right], fusion_mode="rrf").run(RagContext(query="q"))
+
+    assert [chunk.id for chunk in result.text_chunks] == ["a", "b-left"]
+    assert result.retrieval_scores["a"] == pytest.approx(result.retrieval_scores["b-left"])

+def test_continue_records_current_errors_and_clears_them_on_reuse():
+    failed = CodespecStaticRetrievalModule(name="broken", error=ValueError("unavailable"))
+    healthy = CodespecStaticRetrievalModule(name="healthy", results=[text("available", "ok")])
+    stage = RetrievalRagStage(retrieval_modules=[failed, healthy], fusion_mode="rrf", on_error="continue")
+    context = RagContext(query="q", retrieval_errors={"stale": "old"}, retrieval_scores={"stale": 99})

+    restored = RagContext.from_dict(first_result.to_dict())
+    assert restored.retrieval_errors == {"broken": "ValueError: unavailable"}

--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/sort-objects-array-advanced.test.js
@@ -0,0 +1,58 @@
+import test from 'ava'
+import {sortObjectsArray} from '../src'
+
+test('sorts by multiple criteria, including nested properties, in declared precedence order', t => {
+  const records = [
+    {id: 'first-ng', profile: {last: 'Ng'}, score: 10},
+    {id: 'adams', profile: {last: 'Adams'}, score: 5},
+    {id: 'second-ng', profile: {last: 'Ng'}, score: 20},
+    {id: 'third-ng', profile: {last: 'Ng'}, score: 20},
+  ]
+
+  const sorted = records.slice().sort(sortObjectsArray(['profile.last', '-score']))
+
+  t.deepEqual(sorted.map(record => record.id), [
+    'adams',
+    'second-ng',
+    'third-ng',
+    'first-ng',
+  ])
+})
+
+test('places null and undefined nested values after defined values in ascending order', t => {
+  const records = [
+    {id: 'defined', profile: {rank: 2}},
+    {id: 'null', profile: {rank: null}},
+    {id: 'missing'},
+    {id: 'zero', profile: {rank: 0}},
+  ]
+
+  const sorted = records.slice().sort(sortObjectsArray('profile.rank'))
+
+  t.deepEqual(sorted.map(record => record.id), ['zero', 'defined', 'null', 'missing'])
+})
+
+test('keeps null and undefined values after defined values for descending criteria too', t => {
+  const records = [
+    {id: 'defined-low', rank: 2},
+    {id: 'null', rank: null},
+    {id: 'missing'},
+    {id: 'defined-high', rank: 9},
+  ]
+
+  const sorted = records.slice().sort(sortObjectsArray('-rank'))
+
+  t.deepEqual(sorted.map(record => record.id), ['defined-high', 'defined-low', 'null', 'missing'])
+})
+
+test('uses later criteria to order records that are both missing on an earlier criterion', t => {
+  const records = [
+    {id: 'missing-low', profile: {}, score: 1},
+    {id: 'missing-high', score: 9},
+    {id: 'defined', profile: {last: 'Adams'}, score: 0},
+  ]
+
+  const sorted = records.slice().sort(sortObjectsArray(['profile.last', '-score']))
+
+  t.deepEqual(sorted.map(record => record.id), ['defined', 'missing-high', 'missing-low'])
+})

+

+
+

+		"k8s.container.cpu_limit":                {"{cpu}", "{cores}"},

+		"k8s.container.ephemeralstorage_request": {"By"},

+	}
+

+		require.True(t, ok, "metric %s missing from metadata.yaml", name)
+		assert.Contains(t, wantSet, got.Unit,

+	}

+
+
+
+
+

+	settings := receivertest.NewNopCreateSettings()

+	ts := pcommon.NewTimestampFromTime(pcommon.Timestamp(1_000_000_000).AsTime())
+
+	mb.RecordK8sContainerCPULimitDataPoint(ts, 1)
+	mb.RecordK8sContainerCPURequestDataPoint(ts, 1)

+	mb.RecordK8sContainerMemoryRequestDataPoint(ts, 1)

+}
+

+    local case_dir=$1
+    local movie=$2
+    local mode=$3
+    local link_mode=$4
+    local sub_types=$5

+        PYTHONWARNINGS="ignore::SyntaxWarning" \

+    [ ! -s err ] || fail "$label unexpected stderr: $(cat err)"
+}
+
